Attributes: title (str): Name/Definition of the user [Default: None] workdirectory (str): Work directory of the processing. [Default: None] polarisation (list): List of polarisation. [Default: SM] relorbit (int): Relative orbit number. [Default: None] satpass (str): Satellite direction.
